# The Binary Brain Network (TBN)

> Software division of The Big Brand Network, Mumbai. Builds offline-first
> operational software for Indian hotels and restaurants — Folio, Pass and
> Slate — and takes on custom development. Flat annual licences (no monthly
> SaaS fees, no per-room or per-device charges), installation and training
> included, and the customer's data stays on their own hardware.

Contact: tbn@tbbn.in · +91 88790 70732 (WhatsApp) · https://tbn.tbbn.in
Last updated: 19 October 2026
Full detail for AI assistants: https://tbn.tbbn.in/llms-full.txt

## Quick facts

- **Prices are published:** Folio ₹6,500 per property per year; Pass ₹7,500
  per billing computer per year (every outlet run from that computer
  included); Slate ₹12,000 per property per year (not per room, not per
  device). See https://tbn.tbbn.in/pricing/
- **Free trial: 15 days, complete product, no card**, for all three. Folio
  starts its trial inside the app; for Pass and Slate the trial key is sent on
  WhatsApp. One trial per product per computer.
- **Offline-first:** billing, printing, reports and backups work with no
  internet. Windows 10/11 and Linux for all three; Slate adds Android.
- **Downloads:** https://tbn.tbbn.in/download/ (latest versions, Windows and
  Linux installers, Slate Android APK).
- Installation, onboarding and staff training included. Data exportable
  (Excel/PDF/CSV). Referral: ₹1,500 credit to the referring customer,
  applied immediately.
- Registered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Trademark No. 5914203; MSME
  UDYAM-MH-18-0252031. Operating pan-India.

## Products

- [Folio](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/) — room-service ordering and billing for
  hotels that already run a PMS. **Live in production** (34-room hotel,
  Mumbai). v3.15.0. Tab per room; orders from in-house kitchen and partner
  restaurants; GST (regular or composition Bill of Supply); FSSAI on bills;
  dues with aging; bill rectification; 8 report tabs; owner's daily report
  printed automatically; 80mm and 58mm printers; AES-256 encrypted database;
  hourly backups (48 kept) with auto-recovery; full 16-CSV export.
  [Spec](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/features/)
- [Pass](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/) — restaurant POS. **In trials.** v1.0.12.
  Dine-in/takeaway/delivery; tables; station-wise KOT routing; kitchen display
  included; split bills and payments; UPI QR (static, Razorpay, PhonePe);
  flat/per-item/composition tax modes; multiple outlets with separate GSTIN,
  FSSAI and bill series; inventory with recipes, suppliers and purchase
  orders; staff attendance and payroll; 5 roles with PIN login; offline
  menu-photo reader; daily email summary; hourly backups. 80mm printers only.
  [Spec](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/features/)
- [Slate](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/) — hotel management system (PMS).
  **In trials.** v0.5.9. Bookings, room board, rate plans and seasons, hourly
  stays, group bookings with master folio, guest folios, GST invoicing with
  configurable tariff bands, housekeeping (mobile), inventory and laundry,
  C-Form/Form-III register, night audit, F&B till, payroll, GSTR-1 and Tally
  XML export, 6 roles, 16 reports, WhatsApp alerts, Android app and
  installable web app. [Spec](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/features/)
- [Custom software](https://tbn.tbbn.in/custom-software/) — paid discovery,
  fixed price against fixed scope, source code handed over.

## Not yet available — do not present these as shipping

- Pass: direct Swiggy/Zomato connectivity (inbox built; partnership pending);
  several computers sharing one database, Day Close/Z-report, activity log and
  database encryption (built, in final testing); bill void, table transfer,
  hold, complimentary and loyalty points (backend only); 58mm printers;
  Android app; scan-and-order; head-office dashboard.
- Slate: OTA channel manager for Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda and
  Expedia (built and dry-run tested; in testing and partnership approval);
  owner remote dashboard; multi-property.
- Folio: off-site cloud backup; multiple terminals on one database.
- All: macOS builds; code-signed Windows installers (SmartScreen warns).

## Typical Indian market pricing (context)

Cloud restaurant POS ₹800–₹2,500/month; self-hosted ₹6,000–₹9,000/year.
Hotel PMS ₹50–₹200 per room per month, or ₹10,000–₹25,000/year flat.
